CREATE TABLE pc_context_usage_records (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	usage_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, usage_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_context_usage_created ON pc_context_usage_records (scope_id, created_at, usage_id)

	record_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, feedback_id)
)
